summary: The new `norm_tateCurveAt_Δ` proof re-derives the unit/inverse plumbing of the existing `norm_evalIntSeries_eq_one_of_isUnit`, which the PR simultaneously leaves with zero consumers; the generalized argument belongs in `IntegralCoefficients.lean` so the existing lemma becomes its specialization. Two smaller reuse defects: `tateCurveA₆_def` is now an unused defeq restatement of `evalIntSeries_apply`, and the `isUnit_iff_constantCoeff` plumbing is now copied at three sites.
